title: Source verified property data for the permanent-magnet material comparison modules (Ferrite, AlNiCo, SmCo, NdFeB)
question: What are the current, source-backed property values for the four permanent-magnet classes the MAG curriculum compares — Curie temperature, maximum operating temperature, energy product, coercivity, corrosion behaviour, cost and rare-earth raw-material dependence/recycling — so MAG-004/005 can be built on verified data and the KG CON:MAT entities instead of unsourced qualitative comparisons?
why_now: MAG-004 ('Permanentmagnete als Werkstoffe') and MAG-005 ('Magnetismus und Temperatur') are draft KG-facing modules whose learning objectives explicitly require comparing Ferrit, AlNiCo, SmCo and NdFeB on magnetic performance, temperature behaviour, corrosion, cost and raw-material availability, but no sourced numeric property data backs these comparisons in the YAML modules or the magnetism learning path. Rare-earth supply-chain and recycling facts (USGS/IEA critical-minerals data, export controls) change quickly, making a sourced baseline valuable now and reusable across the KG and NOXIA/Mars motor-generator content.
real_world_anchor: Verified property data for Ferrite, AlNiCo, SmCo and NdFeB permanent magnets (Curie temperature, maximum operating temperature, energy product, corrosion behaviour, rare-earth supply/recycling)
